steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Ergonomics ensures products fit the human body — anthropometric data (body measurements) informs design decisions. | Key Fact: The design process for products: brief, research, ideation, development, prototyping, testing, refinement, manufacture. | Key Fact: Prototyping tests ideas before commitment to production — models can be rough (card) or refined (3D printed). | Key Fact: Sustainable design considers the full lifecycle: material sourcing, manufacture, use, and end-of-life disposal or recycling.
